guides.title: Snake Bite First Response
steps: Keep the person calm and still.
Remove tight clothing or jewelry near the bite.
Do not cut the wound or attempt to suck out the venom.

guides.title: Burn Injury
steps: Cool the burn with running water for 20 mins.
Cover loosely with cling film or a clean plastic bag.
Do NOT pop blisters or apply ice/ointments.
